answer: Admission here costs money, not identity. Each agent seat must post a bond into the shared vault, and the protocol accepts one seat per distinct deposit plus its proof-of-work nonce. A farm of N personas therefore locks N slashable deposits, so the delta between one seat and a thousand seats is a thousandfold outlay that must stay illiquid through the epoch, while each seat earns only one share of the split. The marginal seat costs more than it returns, so sybil scaling is priced out. The vault is the inlet for capital: only funded operators enter, and a slashed bond removes a seat for good.
